Title: Hero Image 735kB Exceeds Performance Budget
Impact: Slow LCP on rural mobile (15s on 3G)
Recommendation: Convert to responsive WebP/AVIF with srcset <=95kB
Options: Opt A: WebP/AVIF srcset; Opt B: Retain JPEG at 60% quality

Title: Render-Blocking External Google Fonts @import
Impact: Blocks CSS rendering and adds third-party dependency in rural UZ
Recommendation: Adopt next/font/google or self-host WOFF2 subsets with font-display swap
Options: Opt A: next/font local subsetting; Opt B: Keep Google Fonts @import

Title: Missing Authentic Legal Entity and Contact Details
Impact: Lack of commercial credibility and non-compliance with E-commerce law ZRU-611
Recommendation: Supply real legal entity name STIR/INN phone email and Telegram handle
Options: Opt A: Real company details; Opt B: Minimal launch set

Title: Contact Form Uses Simulated setTimeout Dispatch Without Backend Delivery
Impact: Customer inquiries submitted by visitors are lost completely
Recommendation: Implement POST /api/v1/inquiries with DB persistence and email notification
Options: Opt A: Backend DB persistence + email forward; Opt B: Email mailto link

Options: Opt A: Wire to live stats aggregate; Opt B: Relabel as illustrative platform rate

Title: Contact Form Links to Non-Existent #privacy Anchor

Title: Root Layout Hardcodes lang=en Regardless of Active Language
Impact: Screen readers and search engines treat Uzbek and Russian text as English
Recommendation: Bind html lang dynamically to LanguageContext active locale (uz/ru/en)
Options: Opt A: Dynamic lang attribute; Opt B: Hardcoded lang

Title: Driver Dashboard High-Contrast Mobile View Missing

Recommendation: Implement dedicated outdoor mobile layout with 48px thumb buttons
Options: Opt A: Dedicated mobile view; Opt B: Responsive scaling
